cohort: Pregnant women with appendicitis identified from the Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project-Nationwide Inpatient Sample (2003-2010)
finding: Acute appendicitis during pregnancy was associated with increased risk of preterm birth and abruptio placentae, and these risks were further elevated in the presence of peritonitis.
mod_finding: Pregnant women with appendicitis had an increased risk of cesarean section, and this risk was almost doubled in the presence of peritonitis.
